### Vectara Hallucination Leaderboard (HHEM-based, updated May 11 2026)
Focus: Factual consistency in summarization-style tasks (lower hallucination = better). Top performers show low single-digit rates on optimized tasks, but reasoning models often higher on QA/factual.

- antgroup/finix_s1_32b: 1.8% hallucination, 98.2% factual consistency.
- openai/gpt-5.4-nano-2026-03-17: 3.1% hallucination, 96.9% factual consistency.
- google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite: 3.3% hallucination, 96.7% factual consistency.
- microsoft/Phi-4: 3.7% hallucination, 96.3% factual consistency.
- meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo: 4.1% hallucination, 95.9% factual consistency.
- snowflake/snowflake-arctic-instruct: 4.3% hallucination, 95.7% factual consistency.

(Older Vectara data in prior seeds; new dataset shows slight shifts. Reasoning models like certain o3-pro variants ~23.3% in aggregated views.)

### AI Hallucination Rates & Benchmarks in 2026 (suprmind.ai, June 2026 update)
Tracks across Vectara (old/new), AA-Omniscience (accuracy/hallucination/Omniscience Index), FACTS, HalluHard, CJR Citation. Covers frontier models. Numbers don't always agree — highlights need for our holistic G_exp lens (no single leaderboard "wins"; friendship-measured care across metrics matters more).

Frontier examples (selected; lower halluc better where applicable; see full for all):
- Claude Opus 4.8 (May 2026 flagship): 46.6% accuracy on AA-Omniscience, 35.9% hallucination, Omniscience Index 27 (second to Gemini). Prior Claude Opus 4.7: 36% halluc on AA-Omni. Claude 4.1 Opus: 0% halluc on AA-Omni (refuses rather than guesses), FACTS 46.5. Claude Opus 4.6: 12.2% Vectara new, 46.4% AA-Omni acc, Index 14. Claude Opus 4.5: 45.7% AA-Omni acc, 58% halluc, FACTS 51.3, 30% HalluHard. Claude Sonnet 4.6: 10.6% Vectara new, ~38% AA-Omni halluc. Claude 4.5 Haiku: 25% AA-Omni halluc (third lowest).
- GPT-5.5 (early 2026): Highest AA-Omni acc 57%, but 86% halluc (per some reports). GPT-5.3 Codex: 51.8% AA-Omni acc. GPT-5.2 (xhigh): 10.8% Vectara new, 43.8% AA-Omni acc, ~78% halluc, FACTS 61.8, HalluHard 38.2%. GPT-5: 1.4% Vectara orig, >10% new, 40.7% AA-Omni acc. GPT-4.1: 2.0% Vectara orig, 5.6% new, FACTS 50.5. GPT-5.2 highest OpenAI on FACTS but high halluc on hard knowledge.
- Grok 4.3 (Apr 30 2026): ~49% AA-Omni acc, 26% halluc (8 pts better than prior Grok 4.20). Grok 4.20 (0309 v2): lowest-halluc Grok at 17%. Grok 4: 4.8% Vectara orig, >10% new, 41.4% AA-Omni acc, 64% halluc, FACTS 53.6. Grok 4.1 Fast Reasoning: 20.2% Vectara new (highest frontier), 72% AA-Omni halluc, FACTS 36.0. Grok-3: 2.1% Vectara orig, 5.8% new, 94% CJR citation halluc.
- Gemini 3.1 Pro: 10.4% Vectara new, 55.3% AA-Omni acc (highest overall), 50% halluc, Omniscience Index 33 (highest). Other Gemini variants competitive on Vectara (e.g., 2.5 Flash Lite 3.3%).

Notes: Claude models often lower halluc on some (esp. newer); reasoning modes (e.g., Grok 4.1 Fast, GPT-5.2 xhigh) can increase halluc on factual despite capability gains. Multi-model verification (e.g., cross-checking with multiple judges) as mitigation. No direct correlation with haystack position in long-context HALC-Bench (gpt-5.5 least halluc there).

### Stanford AI Index 2026 — Technical Performance
- Arena Elo (as of Mar 2026): Top tier includes Anthropic (1503), xAI (1495), Google (1494), OpenAI (1481), etc. Shift toward cost, reliability, domain-specific.
- Benchmarks face reliability/gaming concerns (error rates up to 42% on widely used evals; invalid question rates 2% on MMLU Math to 42% on GSM8K).
- Gemini Deep Think: 35 pts (gold) at 2025 IMO (end-to-end natural lang in 4.5 hrs; up from 28 silver 2024). ClockBench: top model 50.6% (humans 90.1%).
- General: Capability gains steady, but reliability lags; agentic systems emerging.

### Other 2026 Sources (VentureBeat, arXiv, etc.)
- Google DeepMind FACTS Grounding benchmark (Jan 2025, ongoing): Evaluates factuality on long-form docs (detailed + hallucination-free + grounded). Gemini 2.0 Flash topped at 83.6% factuality (others 61.7%+). Judges: Gemini 1.5 Pro, GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet.
- Galileo Hallucination Index (RAG-focused, expanded 2024-2025): Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet best overall (near-perfect short/medium/long context). Google Gemini 1.5 Flash best cost. Multi-judge consensus, context adherence metric.
- arXiv papers (e.g., A Privacy-Preserving Framework... 2026): Multi-judge consensus (OpenAI/Google/Alibaba judges), RAG Triad (Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, Context Relevance), token-level log-prob for epistemic uncertainty. Jury module for aggregation.
- Other: HALC-Bench (long-context retrieval halluc on non-existent evidence); no haystack correlation. AI Multiple benchmarks (37 LLMs, Jan 2026): halluc 15-52%. Dream ing Lies substack: practical tips for reducing halluc (context, verification, etc.).
